shots.name: Brief
shots.narration: Your coding agent starts from a brief, and plans every shot before it animates anything.
shots.action: brief.md types in line by line. The benefit line is picked out by an orange highlight: the frame. It lifts off the page and flies to the storyboard.
shots.goal: The film begins from written intent, not from animation.
shots.focalPoint: The orange highlight on the benefit line.
shots.transition: The highlight lifts off as the frame and lands on the first storyboard cell, already in place.
shots.sound: Sparse pads and a soft pulse; one soft whoosh as the frame lifts.

shots.name: Plan
shots.narration: Each shot records its goal, its focal point, and what carries forward.
shots.action: A six-cell storyboard strip. The frame selects a cell and its goal, focal point, and transition fill in; it moves to the next cell and the fields change in place. motion-mania plan returns timing valid, no open questions.
shots.goal: Each shot has a written job before anything moves.
shots.focalPoint: The selected cell, then its filled-in fields.
shots.transition: The frame pushes into the third cell and becomes the preview beside the code.
shots.sound: Kick and shaker enter; a light tick as each field lands, a soft confirm on the plan result.

shots.name: Build
shots.narration: The animation is ordinary code, rendered into real frames you can inspect.
shots.action: A code editor beside the preview frame. As each timeline line is highlighted, its element moves in the preview. motion-mania review --draft is typed; the preview flashes like a shutter.
shots.goal: Show that each line of code causes a specific motion.
shots.focalPoint: The highlighted code line, then the element it moves.
shots.transition: A camera flash and a hard cut: the frame shrinks from the preview onto one frame of the draft's contact sheet.
shots.sound: Bass arpeggio joins; the shutter lands on the cut.

shots.name: Evidence
shots.narration: Contact sheets, cut strips, and charts of the sound and motion show what actually rendered.
shots.action: A contact sheet, a nine-frame cut strip, a waveform and an activity chart marked with the cuts draw in. The frame selects one thumbnail, then settles on a red frozen stretch in the activity chart.
shots.goal: The evidence is concrete and inspectable, and it can find a problem.
shots.focalPoint: The contact sheet, then the frozen stretch the frame lands on.
shots.transition: The frozen stretch becomes the first finding in the critique.
shots.sound: Full groove; a low accent when the frozen stretch is marked.
shots.hold: Reading time for the evidence panels.

shots.name: Second opinion
shots.narration: Then a second agent reviews each round, and checks that every fix really landed.
shots.action: critique.md lists three real findings from this film's earlier drafts: the frozen stretch, the shutter, the empty headline slot. A blue critic cursor verifies each; they flip to fixed while the verdict counts down from three open to ship.
shots.goal: A separate reviewer, not the builder, decides the film is done.
shots.focalPoint: Each finding as it flips to fixed, then the verdict.
shots.transition: The frame around the verdict grows and splits into the two delivered formats.
shots.sound: Drums thin out; a clean tick on each fixed, a soft chime on ship.

shots.name: Ship
shots.copy: Motion Mania. From repo to reel.
shots.action: The frame splits into landscape and portrait exports, which fold into the Motion Mania lockup and the init command.
shots.goal: Leave the viewer with the name and the first command to run.
shots.transition: Hold the lockup to the end.
shots.sound: A resolving chord on the lockup, then ring-out; no narration.
shots.hold: The lockup and command need reading time.
